when_used: A lessee surrenders a registered lease back to the lessor, who accepts the surrender, so that the lease can be closed on the register.

detail_rows.label: Entry No. in the Encumbrances Section

body_text.text: * (the receipt whereof is hereby acknowledged by the Lessor)* the Lessee HEREBY SURRENDERS the Lease comprised in the above-mentioned Title and the Lessor HEREBY ACCEPTS the said Surrender.
IN WITNESS this Surrender of Lease has been duly executed by the parties hereto.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this discharge has been duly executed this ...........…. day of………………………….., 20….

foot_notes: All parties including the Guarantor(s) must execute.
**The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.name: consideration
custom_fields.label: Consideration for the surrender
custom_fields.prompt: What is given for the surrender, in words and figures, or the words the parties use where none passes

custom_fields.name: entry_no_encumbrances
custom_fields.label: Entry number in the Encumbrances Section
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number under which the lease being surrendered is registered

custom_fields.name: demised_premises
custom_fields.label: Demised premises
custom_fields.prompt: The premises comprised in the lease being surrendered

custom_fields.name: term
custom_fields.label: Term of the lease
custom_fields.prompt: The term of the lease being surrendered, with its commencement date

custom_fields.name: guarantor
custom_fields.label: Guarantor
custom_fields.prompt: The guarantor under the lease, where there is one
